title: Level-rank dualities and moving vectors
summary: Duality relations between Lie algebras are a significant phenomenon in Lie algebra representation theory, with level-rank duality as a famous example. Level-rank dualities for affine Lie algebras of type $A^{(1)}$ were first discovered by Frenkel in 1982, and later extended to all classical non-twisted affine types by Hasegawa in 1989 through elaborate character calculations.
